title: Resonances at finite temperature from the lattice
summary: The properties of hadronic resonances at finite temperature constitute an important probe of the thermal QCD medium. In this work we use the concept of thermoparticles, which characterise thermally-modified but stable particle-like states, to define the notion of two-particle scattering at finite temperature, and establish a unitarity relation for the thermal scattering amplitude. We derive a finite-temperature generalisation of the vacuum two-particle quantisation condition via a skeleton expansion of the finite-volume correlation function.
